{
  "$schema": "https://json.schemastore.org/claude-code-plugin-manifest.json",
  "name": "crew-chief",
  "displayName": "Crew Chief",
  "version": "0.3.1",
  "description": "Difficulty-based routing for Claude Code. You pick the main model and effort; Claude decides what to do itself and what to hand to tiered Haiku, Sonnet, and Opus subagents (including browser and emulator UI testers), escalates when a tier gets stuck, and follows your overrides like \"do it yourself\" or \"give this to Sonnet at medium\".",
  "author": {
    "name": "aykyusuf",
    "url": "https://github.com/aykyusuf"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/aykyusuf/crew-chief",
  "repository": "https://github.com/aykyusuf/crew-chief",
  "documentationUrl": "https://github.com/aykyusuf/crew-chief#readme",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/aykyusuf/crew-chief/issues",
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://github.com/aykyusuf/crew-chief#privacy",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "subagents",
    "routing",
    "model-selection",
    "effort",
    "cost",
    "delegation",
    "haiku",
    "sonnet",
    "opus"
  ]
}
